parameters.content:
✈️ SkyFlow Flight Management System

Backend: https://hackathon-production-4daa.up.railway.app
Database: Supabase PostgreSQL (shared ledger)
n8n: Scheduled automation, RAG support, Gmail, Fraud review

Credentials required:
1. Postgres account      → Supabase connection
2. Gmail account         → Gmail OAuth2
3. Google Gemini(PaLM)  → Embeddings
4. Groq account          → LLM drafting
5. Pinecone account      → Vector store

Env vars:
  OPERATIONS_EMAIL — admin email for approvals/reports
  FMS_BACKEND_URL  — FastAPI backend URL

🔄 KEEP-ALIVE FLOW
Runs every 6 days at 3 AM
Prevents Supabase free-tier hibernation

parameters.query:
SELECT
  b.id AS booking_id,
  u.full_name,
  u.email,
  f.flight_number,
  f.origin,
  f.destination,
  f.departure_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS departure_at
FROM bookings b
JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id
JOIN flights f ON f.id = b.flight_id
LEFT JOIN notification_logs n
  ON n.booking_id = b.id AND n.notification_type = 'CHECKIN_REMINDER'
WHERE b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
  AND f.status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND f.departure_at BETWEEN NOW() + INTERVAL '23 hours' AND NOW() + INTERVAL '25 hours'
  AND n.id IS NULL;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  f.flight_number,
  f.origin,
  f.destination,
  f.status,
  COALESCE(SUM(si.total_seats), 0) AS total_seats,
  COALESCE(SUM(si.total_seats - si.available_seats - si.held_seats), 0) AS booked_seats,
  COALESCE(SUM(si.held_seats), 0) AS held_seats,
  COALESCE(SUM(b.total_amount), 0) AS revenue,
  f.departure_at::date AS departure_date
FROM flights f
LEFT JOIN seat_inventory si ON si.flight_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.flight_id = f.id AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
WHERE f.status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND f.departure_at >= NOW()
  AND f.departure_at < NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY f.id, f.flight_number, f.origin, f.destination, f.status, f.departure_at
ORDER BY f.departure_at;

parameters.subject: =📊 SkyFlow Daily Ops Report — {{ new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] }}

parameters.query:
SELECT
  f.flight_number,
  f.origin,
  f.destination,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS bookings_this_week,
  COALESCE(SUM(si.total_seats), 0) AS total_capacity,
  COALESCE(SUM(si.total_seats - si.available_seats - si.held_seats), 0) AS booked_seats,
  COALESCE(SUM(b.total_amount), 0) AS weekly_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN b.id END) AS cancellations,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS refunds_issued
FROM flights f
LEFT JOIN seat_inventory si ON si.flight_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.flight_id = f.id AND b.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.booking_id = b.id
WHERE f.departure_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY f.id, f.flight_number, f.origin, f.destination
ORDER BY weekly_revenue DESC;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  r.id AS refund_id,
  r.booking_id,
  r.amount,
  r.currency,
  r.created_at,
  b.booking_reference,
  u.email AS passenger_email,
  u.full_name AS passenger_name,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - r.created_at)) / 86400 AS days_pending
FROM refunds r
JOIN bookings b ON b.id = r.booking_id
JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id
WHERE r.status = 'PENDING'
  AND r.escalation_sent_at IS NULL
  AND r.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days'
ORDER BY r.created_at ASC;

parameters.query: UPDATE refunds SET escalation_sent_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $json.refund_id }}'::uuid;

WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT w.id
  FROM waitlist_entries w
  JOIN seat_inventory s ON s.flight_id = w.flight_id AND s.seat_class = w.seat_class
  JOIN flights f ON f.id = w.flight_id
  WHERE w.status = 'WAITING'
    AND f.status <> 'CANCELLED'
    AND f.departure_at > NOW()
    AND s.available_seats >= 1
  ORDER BY w.priority_score ASC, w.created_at ASC
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE waitlist_entries w
SET
  status = 'PROMOTED',
  promoted_at = NOW()
FROM candidate c
WHERE w.id = c.id
RETURNING
  w.id AS waitlist_id,
  w.user_id,
  w.flight_id,
  w.passenger_name,
  w.email,
  w.seat_class,
  w.fare_type,
  w.promoted_at;

SELECT
  w.passenger_name AS full_name,
  w.email,
  f.flight_number,
  f.origin,
  f.destination,
  f.departure_at,
  w.seat_class,
  w.fare_type,
  w.promoted_at,
  w.promoted_at + INTERVAL '2 hours' AS claim_deadline
FROM waitlist_entries w
JOIN flights f ON f.id = w.flight_id
WHERE w.id = '{{ $json.waitlist_id }}'::uuid;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  b.id,
  b.booking_reference,
  b.user_id,
  b.flight_id,
  b.fare_type,
  b.total_amount,
  b.created_at,
  COUNT(p.id) AS passenger_count,
  u.email
FROM bookings b
JOIN passengers p ON p.booking_id = b.id AND p.status = 'CONFIRMED'
JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id
WHERE b.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
GROUP BY b.id, b.booking_reference, b.user_id, b.flight_id, b.fare_type, b.total_amount, b.created_at, u.email;

INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, actor_role, action, entity_type, entity_id, new_data, reason, created_at)
VALUES (

  'FRAUD_SCAN_RESULT',

  jsonb_build_object(
    'booking_reference', '{{ $json.booking_reference }}',
    'risk_score', {{ $json.risk_score }},
    'risk_flags', '{{ $json.risk_flags }}',
    'high_risk', {{ $json.high_risk }},
    'passenger_count', {{ $json.passenger_count }},
    'total_amount', '{{ $json.total_amount }}'
  ),
  'Scheduled recent booking fraud scan (last 24h)',

);

SELECT
  b.id,
  b.booking_reference,
  b.user_id,
  b.flight_id,
  b.fare_type,
  b.total_amount,
  b.created_at,
  b.status,
  b.cancellation_policy
FROM bookings b
WHERE b.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, actor_role, action, entity_type, entity_id, new_data, reason, created_at)
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(),
  'SYSTEM',
  'HISTORICAL_FRAUD_REVIEW',
  'booking',
  '{{ $json.id }}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'booking_reference', '{{ $json.booking_reference }}',
    'status', '{{ $json.status }}',
    'fare_type', '{{ $json.fare_type }}',
    'cancellation_policy', '{{ $json.cancellation_policy }}',
    'total_amount', '{{ $json.total_amount }}'
  ),
  'Weekly historical booking fraud review batch',
  NOW()
);

WITH booking_fares AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS booking_id,
    b.booking_reference,
    b.user_id,
    b.flight_id,
    b.seat_class,
    b.fare_type,
    b.total_amount,
    b.currency,
    COUNT(p.id) AS passenger_count,
    b.total_amount / NULLIF(COUNT(p.id), 0) AS paid_per_seat
  FROM bookings b
  JOIN passengers p ON p.booking_id = b.id AND p.status = 'CONFIRMED'
  WHERE b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
  GROUP BY b.id, b.booking_reference, b.user_id, b.flight_id, b.seat_class, b.fare_type, b.total_amount, b.currency
)
SELECT
  bf.booking_id,
  bf.booking_reference,
  u.email,
  u.full_name,
  f.flight_number,
  f.origin,
  f.destination,
  f.departure_at,
  bf.seat_class,
  bf.fare_type,
  bf.paid_per_seat,
  CASE WHEN bf.fare_type = 'BASIC' THEN si.fare_basic ELSE si.fare_flexible END AS current_fare,
  bf.currency,
  ROUND(CAST((bf.paid_per_seat - CASE WHEN bf.fare_type = 'BASIC' THEN si.fare_basic ELSE si.fare_flexible END) AS numeric), 2) AS savings_per_seat,
  ROUND(CAST(((bf.paid_per_seat - CASE WHEN bf.fare_type = 'BASIC' THEN si.fare_basic ELSE si.fare_flexible END) / NULLIF(bf.paid_per_seat, 0) * 100) AS numeric), 1) AS drop_pct
FROM booking_fares bf
JOIN users u ON u.id = bf.user_id
JOIN flights f ON f.id = bf.flight_id
JOIN seat_inventory si ON si.flight_id = bf.flight_id AND si.seat_class = bf.seat_class
LEFT JOIN notification_logs n
  ON n.booking_id = bf.booking_id
  AND n.notification_type = 'PRICE_DROP'
  AND n.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
WHERE f.status = 'SCHEDULED'
  AND f.departure_at > NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day'
  AND n.id IS NULL
  AND CASE WHEN bf.fare_type = 'BASIC' THEN si.fare_basic ELSE si.fare_flexible END < bf.paid_per_seat * 0.90
ORDER BY drop_pct DESC;

parameters.subject: =💰 Price Drop Alert — {{ $json.flight_number }} ({{ $json.drop_pct }}% cheaper!)
parameters.message:

Route{{ $json.origin }} → {{ $json.destination }}
Departure{{ $json.departure_at }}
Class{{ $json.seat_class }} ({{ $json.fare_type }})
You Paid{{ $json.currency }} {{ $json.paid_per_seat }} per seat

parameters.query:
SELECT
  b.id AS booking_id,
  b.booking_reference,
  b.fare_type,
  b.cancellation_policy,
  b.flight_cancellation_outcome AS cancellation_outcome,
  b.status,
  u.full_name,
  u.email,
  f.flight_number,
  f.origin,
  f.destination
FROM bookings b
JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id
JOIN flights f ON f.id = b.flight_id
WHERE b.booking_reference = '{{ $json.booking_reference }}'
LIMIT 1;
